Meet Coach Tuberville:

**
**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989, Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime._

_Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his home state of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support?_ ** **

Across the country, voters are standing up, rejecting the status quo, and calling for new leadership. Nassau can do the same. Here’s my plan to move us forward: 💰 Cut wasteful government spending, end costly political favoritism, and cut taxes 👮♂️ Fully staff Nassau’s detective unit, boost neighborhood patrols, and eliminate Blakeman’s reckless militia 🏡 Fix Nassau’s broken property tax assessment system to ensure fair, accurate valuations for everyone 🗳️ It’s time for real solutions. It’s time for new leadership. It’s time for us to step up together. Let’s do this, Seth Koslow P.S If you haven’t RSVP’d for my Spring Gala this Monday, | * | Paid for by Koslow for Nassau Koslow for Nassau 998 Old Country Road STE C Box 152 Plainview, NY 11803 United States We try to send only the most important info and opportunities to participate via email, but if you want to, you can .

**Fellow Patriot,**
**This foldable, lightweight drone lets you record ALL your epic adventures!** [**Get yours now!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21550/6374453/5cc152ec5bbcc54ae85b79f822df832655950b97/339d91b2ca330dd43b211e6949c989d24548fc43)
The**Skyhawk 4K** is a precision engineered drone specifically designed for easy flying, making it perfect to fly inside, or to record while on the move.
---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21550/6374453/2c59507a037ad002851f8800e3c1f8a51f33c490/339d91b2ca330dd43b211e6949c989d24548fc43)
---
**It’s foldable** ... The propellers fold in to make it easier to hide or carry!
**Records video** in HD at 60 frames per second and takes high res photos.
**Gravity Sensors** ... Detects ground and other obstacles and changes course automatically to avoid collisions. And more! [**Yes, Please Rush My Skyhawk 4K Drone to My Doorstep Today!**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21550/6374453/5cc152ec5bbcc54ae85b79f822df832655950b97/339d91b2ca330dd43b211e6949c989d24548fc43)
These drones are flying off the shelves for good reason ...
It’s the most advanced drone you’ll get at this price.
No doubt you’ll find 100 uses for this drone!

Jason Crow For Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/logoJC%20(1).png]

body:
That’s a REAL quote from Iowa Senator Joni Ernst after being confronted about Medicaid cuts
#
**_“Well, we all are going to die.”_**
Peter — that’s a REAL quote from Joni Ernst — the GOP U.S. Senator currently up for re-election in Iowa — after she was confronted by constituents during a town hall this week about GOP cuts to Medicaid.

| | **_Meet Kat_** Kat Cammack is currently serving her third term representing the FREE state of Florida in the People’s House as FL-03 Congresswoman. And her road from the small cattle ranch she grew up on to the halls of Congress in our nation’s capital has been far from ordinary. A third generation commercial sandblaster, Kat originally aspired to take over her family’s business and continue the rural, rodeo lifestyle she had grown so accustomed to. That was until a failed Obama-era housing policy caused Kat’s family to lose their ranch, leaving her and her mother homeless. They lived in their car and bounced from cheap motel to cheap motel just to keep a roof over their heads. But overcoming these hardships moulded Kat into the gritty and unapologetic leader she is today. After her family’s livelihood was destroyed by big government, she made it her life mission to deliver federal reform in the DC Swamp for the American people. So she packed her belongings and moved to Florida’s 3rd Congressional District – where she would serve as a Deputy Chief of Staff for nearly a decade before running for Congress herself. After emerging victorious in a brutal, 10-way GOP primary contest, the people of FL-03 elected Kat to serve them in the People’s House in November of 2020. Throughout her journey from homelessness to the House of Representatives, Kat Cammack has shown unwavering and unapologetic grit in her fight for the American people. And she has no plans of backing down until we truly have a government for the people, by the people once again here in the United States. When she’s not going toe-to-toe with the Washington Swamp, Kat enjoys spending time with her loving husband Matt – who serves as a firefighter and SWAT Medic with the Gainesville Fire Rescue. In the little spare time that they have, you can find Kat and Matt fishing, skeet shooting, or watching Gators football. They are incredibly proud to call north central Florida’s “Gator Nation” home. Go Gators, and let’s keep Florida the most FREE state in the union!

Sincerely, Team Kat | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Meet Kat Kat Cammack is currently serving her third term representing the FREE state of Florida in the People’s House as FL-03 Congresswoman. And her road from the small cattle ranch she grew up on to the halls of Congress in our nation’s capital has been far from ordinary. A third generation commercial sandblaster, Kat originally aspired to take over her family’s business and continue the rural, rodeo lifestyle she had grown so accustomed to. That was until a failed Obama-era housing policy caused Kat’s family to lose their ranch, leaving her and her mother homeless. They lived in their car and bounced from cheap motel to cheap motel just to keep a roof over their heads. But overcoming these hardships moulded Kat into the gritty and unapologetic leader she is today. After her family’s livelihood was destroyed by big government, she made it her life mission to deliver federal reform in the DC Swamp for the American people. So she packed her belongings and moved to Florida’s 3rd Congressional District – where she would serve as a Deputy Chief of Staff for nearly a decade before running for Congress herself. After emerging victorious in a brutal, 10-way GOP primary contest, the people of FL-03 elected Kat to serve them in the People’s House in November of 2020. Throughout her journey from homelessness to the House of Representatives, Kat Cammack has shown unwavering and unapologetic grit in her fight for the American people. And she has no plans of backing down until we truly have a government for the people, by the people once again here in the United States. When she’s not going toe-to-toe with the Washington Swamp, Kat enjoys spending time with her loving husband Matt – who serves as a firefighter and SWAT Medic with the Gainesville Fire Rescue. In the little spare time that they have, you can find Kat and Matt fishing, skeet shooting, or watching Gators football. They are incredibly proud to call north central Florida’s “Gator Nation” home. Go Gators, and let’s keep Florida the most FREE state in the union! | | | | A Message From Congresswoman Kat, to You Peter, the opportunity to fight for YOU in the Washington Swamp has been the greatest honor of my life. If we’re going to guarantee a free and prosperous country for future generations of Americans, we need to shake up the status quo in our nation’s capital by cutting reckless government spending, securing our borders, and putting America FIRST in all facets of government operation once again. America’s firefighters are on the frontlines of the climate crisis, working to prevent the devastating wildfires that threaten our homes and livelihoods each year.

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108678078/548667093/-935925420?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250530_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjkzMmU2YS04YTNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=geUsRmWWTd9kOvIC6wJygiMCrqlV2fjG-yvNSyU_O7I=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108678079/548667094/-935925420?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250530_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjkzMmU2YS04YTNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=geUsRmWWTd9kOvIC6wJygiMCrqlV2fjG-yvNSyU_O7I=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the threat of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. [**Can I count on you to join our coalition today by chipping in $3 toward our $25,000 End-of-Month goal? If thousands of people like you each chip in what they can afford, I know we can take on their dark money and handle whatever the GOP trifecta throws our way. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108678080/548667095/-935925420?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250530_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjkzMmU2YS04YTNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=geUsRmWWTd9kOvIC6wJygiMCrqlV2fjG-yvNSyU_O7I=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $3 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108678087/548667102/-935925420?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20250530_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjkzMmU2YS04YTNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=geUsRmWWTd9kOvIC6wJygiMCrqlV2fjG-yvNSyU_O7I=)

Fellow Conservative, four decades ago, I joined the Atlanta Police Department as a beat cop.

My first assignment was walking high crime foot patrol on Auburn Avenue. Eventually, I became chief of police in Doraville, a small community northeast of Atlanta. During my career in law enforcement, I locked up drug dealers, arrested and deported criminals here illegally, and did everything I could to keep the community safe.

**I have some scars to show for it: I was shot and stabbed in the line of duty.**

That didn’t break me; it strengthened my resolve. During my career as a law enforcement officer, I busted criminals, yes, but I also built bridges with diverse communities and saw neighbors helping neighbors.

**I know how important it is to support law enforcement and first responders.

Soft-on-crime policies and weak leadership make our communities less safe. In the Senate, I’ll always Back the Blue and work with President Trump to make our country safer and more secure.**

[**But I can’t do it without your support.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=9dffaf7d96c2409d8a6d1da81ec17cb3&_e=XwVaxAPXXSKrdVWC5CXgjzVslvFvCHgqP-DH7lllSK9pPRvEYGiO27yM0Y_G4f_UYpzRyohv8GQxc_mUh67wVe2Pd7UqwYeF7441i0vIwJHlZ2SO923PD6L6060vPjZC_2lhNxTGrtS8hSuKZDFbn7FjJ-KLNYqRqcmG0IJqFEp_zAqOwzc66d-CuzIXXe7v7niLZPKZ6lQe6lBdoigUzNPR_CNTXMTRB8WIVl0z3Hbfw9FILZw7ifh1GHf6N_yl5iekDxzQu2VGfqIE7jUqbQ8yL-0ofb7f_KTINz2on5G2zncN9ptO_rNL-B2dVeq9XC8qXk6izkomkwLp5l_yLzF3cK2esQj_DGvbgJYExbRqAb_T159JpVQMHwT7HPbtUxlRcv8-qoTNGBnOjAq2Ow%3D%3D)

[1]Justice Democrats

It’s time to raise the alarm,
Peter: AIPAC, Crypto, and their affiliated dark
money super PACs are coming for the Squad and other Justice Democrats in
2026.

The American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC) takes checks from
Trump-supporting millionaire and billionaire megadonors and lobbies
Congress for unconditional support for Israel while spending hundreds of
millions of dollars attacking progressive, pro-Palestinian candidates in
Democratic primaries.

They did it last cycle when they unseated progressive champions Cori Bush
and Jamaal Bowman, and reports indicate they’re getting ready to do it all
over again in 2026, setting their sights on remaining Squad members like
Rep. Ilhan Omar.

In a new Politico article, the spokesperson for one of AIPAC’s super PACs
said they’re “looking at both Republican and Democratic opportunities” to
expand “the pro-Israel bipartisan majority in Congress” and “anticipates
being highly-involved in a number of races opposing anti-Israel
incumbents, defending pro-Israel Members of Congress against anti-Israel
challengers, and in open seats where there is a detractor of the US-Israel
relationship.” To summarize, they’re gearing up to take down any Democrat
with the courage to support a permanent ceasefire in Gaza and oppose the
genocide of Palestinians.

Similarly, the pro-Crypto group Fairshake PAC, which has spent millions
against Justice Democrats candidates and progressives in previous
elections, said “everything is on the table.”

AIPAC and Crypto were two of the largest political spenders in the 2024
cycle, and they’re clearly getting ready to spend even more in 2026 to try
to destroy our progressive movement of leaders who put people before
profits.

They want to unseat the Squad completely to maintain the status quo and
their grip on power in Washington. This is a David vs. Goliath fight
between genocide and peace, between the working class and billionaire
elites. We need to prepare NOW.

| | _**Protecting our Communities and Honoring our Veterans**_
---
Friends,

This week, Governor Braun signed two major public safety bills: Senate Enrolled Act 324 and House Enrolled Act 1014. “Keeping Hoosiers safe is our top priority, and we’ve secured several wins for public safety this session," said Governor Braun. "These bills will increase the penalty for pushing fentanyl on our streets, help keep police officers safe, and make our communities safer for Hoosier families.” SEA 324 increases penalties for fentanyl-related offenses and strengthens domestic violence protections by allowing courts to require electronic monitoring as a condition of bail. Governor Braun thanked Senator Aaron Freeman, the bill’s author, and Representative Chris Jeter, its sponsor, for their leadership. HEA 1014 outlines a comprehensive set of public safety reforms. It establishes that committing a crime while in the country illegally or distributing controlled substances are aggravating factors in sentencing, and prohibits the use of public funds for organizing sexually explicit performances. The law reinforces that force against officers during arrest is never justified and encourages substance abuse treatment as a mitigating factor in sentencing, reflecting Indiana’s ongoing commitment to public safety. On May 29th, Governor Mike Braun joined fellow Hoosier elected officials in welcoming Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins for coin recognition ceremonies and visits to Crown Hill Cemetery and the Richard L. Roudebush VA Medical Center. These events served as a meaningful tribute to the service and sacrifice of Indiana’s veterans. Governor Braun emphasized the importance of honoring those who have served our country with distinction, reaffirming his commitment to ensuring they receive the full support and recognition they deserve. He also expressed his gratitude to Secretary Collins and his team for their ongoing dedication to improving the lives of Hoosier veterans. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman

"These bills will increase the penalty for pushing fentanyl on our streets, help keep police officers safe, and make our communities safer for Hoosier families.” SEA 324 increases penalties for fentanyl-related offenses and strengthens domestic violence protections by allowing courts to require electronic monitoring as a condition of bail. Governor Braun thanked Senator Aaron Freeman, the bill’s author, and Representative Chris Jeter, its sponsor, for their leadership. HEA 1014 outlines a comprehensive set of public safety reforms. It establishes that committing a crime while in the country illegally or distributing controlled substances are aggravating factors in sentencing, and prohibits the use of public funds for organizing sexually explicit performances. The law reinforces that force against officers during arrest is never justified and encourages substance abuse treatment as a mitigating factor in sentencing, reflecting Indiana’s ongoing commitment to public safety. Governor Braun emphasized the importance of honoring those who have served our country with distinction, reaffirming his commitment to ensuring they receive the full support and recognition they deserve. ## High School Seniors Get Tearful Baseball Send-Off
Graduating seniors of a South Carolina high school baseball**** team got a [heartfelt send-off](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFqtDAURp8m7iLJTcz4L7L4odjVdNulxORGU67eQcMMvn2x0Cfo-sDHOd_nfbyHQmWbP8KKPs95rJnHDV8HYa24j1M4cApEB26Jc668byHxC9MICjqpOmnUmEKhc7RN8hkR0DTo9c32znTO2mbxUU9ORdQu9Mb2nXKQdPoXpwC5c5NyTfHXmuqMAqVuYNqpjxac0tmoCDndhFWYSuW9_eKy1QUznfzEvY28NuSXWh-HMP8FDAKGMMWroJ35wgKG9_tFhrAWOgUMS5kXecSFmeRvn6wYVvkseyCJK9fCWyB5VUvOWcBwVN5PYYaShHnTAFpb05tm9-nxKkTlcJfkvIZCP1L1z28-PXwHAAD__xdVidk) when each took a final at-bat, facing pitches from their own fathers. As they rounded the bases, personal letters from their parents were read aloud over the stadium PA, bringing players and parents alike to tears. [Watch the video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M1q6zAUBOCnkXYx8jmy5Sy0uHDJLoWuCt0I_RzZahUr2EpE3r64r9DtDHwD83E1V5tyWuc3eyMd52hqLGaltmeqlTbj7E7O5rzTGkqMtWyrDaVRMCBgOInhhMIEm_LLSB50JAJCTrpXchpxGKXki-4nFc7CBTpLp7BXEeRkA8I5-h7RDjzpQxMDChBCAXZu8hJG0UcUHmJQTAoKqZat-ypprQvF_CpP2jpfbjzrpdb7zvAfgwuDS2ute5VHfTg6-iOx1S8ML0-G_0G-z5_f8JC-8E2He0s5p308JuabTfmXrH_-4qnhJwAA__-rWnOi). The team capped the night with a win—and a send-off they’ll never forget.
## Old Laptop Unlocks Boyhood Story
Noah Simmons, a 28-year-old from Bristol, Virginia, purchased [an old laptop at an estate sale for $20](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUxfGnsTcizIftDAxdsqVrR4ThklBdgwXXdvP2VfoKnY909NP_627vLmHKj0-3gomPaCkWm-FsCERQ7eIaLA6xQQ4lRio1u1BOCFZwoRnXTHIbXMKXVX0wEUCA7MEMk5pHqUel-qdRwV29nAZQo1JaSwF88ddlFlKreB1cn8z7jWvJBeeTkJdl9kqMfIiSexHD1CkOIVGpl--SMj0h4qscUC--rD2aJ9HWOvnRiVsnbhuUDeE9deK2usyW_dVYwcB8WbedoDJHDBo5AtYcAosph8a2Ckcqe2PlzFAZ_HjcWzqADcMkp3mc-2rCdibE1MY36bG6hH8E-ne7w4jfAAAA__-TS4XV), initially aiming for retro gaming consoles. On the laptop, he found a heartfelt story titled _A Secret Place_ by 11-year-old Drew Smallwood, describing cherished memories of time spent with friends in a treehouse. After sharing the [discovery on social media](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk8D3UTGNpAULrahy7ZbojEeh1kZG-FJIm6_Yq_w15_09L735zk_kRPn12_cyMVXnCWWOdO3JhKhY_ZYyWNKlXIoMUo5MobypTBrpXtQPRg1B-R0zrYNLhJpMi25brT3wfSDte3q4qhwCV1Auyy9snf18GQ765UhE_2gWnYXTfVGaaVGbW7-vlg9qC4ategYxsYqCizluP0tnGWlmM7yoeO2lK1NbhXZa2N-NXpq9ET5hvVaGj1tdHAVFC650dN1rNETwoYZ_PusgNA9HiMk3KXsgDnAglnAU2L6EHxXlAqcKwcCjiArV3iRVJACZ3nDygIbwXuHi98eLuxfTonrcDm_NuT031F-HPfj9L8AAAD__2cdkPU), Simmons located Smallwood, now 33 and living in Nashville, Tennessee. They connected via video call and learned the laptop belonged to Smallwood’s grandfather. The two, bonded by shared interests, plan to meet in person to explore more of the laptop’s contents, with Simmons hoping the story inspires others to embrace simpler times.
## Service Dog Honored Alongside College Graduate
Cecilia Hernandez, a 22-year-old honors chemistry graduate from Rollins College, was joined by her service dog, Canela, at her May commencement, where Canela received a special patch for her contributions. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvgzAQBeBfg7cg52wDGTxUqrKlS4dmsw58B64cHIGDRX99Rf9C1_ek70nv6-ZuGGKYxw98kOWRXebkZiprpJxpcT2u1GOMK80-Mee0zOhTIe9AgjlJc1LSeQxxd1p4y0RASpA9t7prlGm0FpPFCyLzAMp3BnTLCNwBnpvWaFDaowj20KRREqRsQdV9N2ho5JmVHIB9W2lJPuS01N8pzHkijnvaaKmH9BDRTjk_10q9VXCt4FpKqff0yq-ejv5IMA9Tpa5bpd5_5Cea52W730exWP8sIcawNsfE-MAQ_8j87y82C78BAAD__xl7dDI). Canela, a golden retriever, supported Hernandez through health challenges like endometriosis, rheumatoid arthritis, and cardiac issues, alerting her to flare-ups and accompanying her in the lab with specialized protective gear, including goggles and booties. [See photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L_OnDAQBPCngc4n439whYs0131pUyKfd202Mt5PxgHd20fkFVJNMxr9NL--1q9AhWr-GXb0Kae1J14rXkfB3rGt73DgO5RyYAVOqXOrAfhCWJVUVkgrtFwhUPmsZgSfEBXqEf00m8Vp64wZNz9P9g0zGFicTvh0uBgln9FqbY2yCCP5e01aLZWUs9KP9xKNcnJKWkaVYB6MRKDO7fGbqfYNU_nwie0ReR-L33r_Pgb9Y1CvQb2u63pkZti5Vao57Ngohrs6qFehk2oe1Ovo3D53YjspogDOYuPKDUGEwjUfBCgil4IZRW4B_oSOIm6IjWoWk5qeZnk6NzYP3xeVQoe7oXkPVP7B-n8_enr1NwAA___G-Y3r). Hernandez, who thought she might not make it to graduation during her freshman year, credited Canela’s presence for her success and plans to pursue a Ph.D. in inorganic chemistry at the University of Central Florida.

body:
Healthy waters = healthy ecosystem

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680906/548676295/-1299648888?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&sourceid=1166936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
---
Peter,
Have you ever followed a stream just to see where it goes?
Within Monte Rio Redwoods, if you sit beside a quiet stream, you’ll discover the source of something much bigger. This 1,517-acre property is home to the headwaters of three critical tributaries of the Russian River: Dutch Bill Creek, Freezeout Creek, and Willow Creek.
[**This is the magic and importance of Monte Rio Redwoods. Within these forests is a life-giving source that touches thousands of lives—including people like you and me.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680907/548676296/2018652235?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&ms=MonteRio5_Link1&sourceid=1166936&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680908/548676297/2018652235?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&ms=MonteRio5_Image1&sourceid=1166936&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
_Photo by Smith Robinson Multimedia_
If you think I’m exaggerating, think again! The health of downstream ecosystems depends on the health of their headwaters. In the redwoods, rainwater, springs, fog drip, and other surface runoff water accumulates in these headwater streams, and then flows down into larger streams, rivers, lakes, and oceans.
**What happens to these headwaters affects the health and resilience of the land and wildlife downstream.**
The headwaters within Monte Rio Redwoods add up to 3.7 miles of streams that support critical spawning sites for coho salmon and steelhead trout downstream. The input of forest debris and aquatic life in the headwater streams provide important food sources for fish and other downstream wildlife. Headwater nutrient inputs support healthy stream vegetation that provides wildlife habitat and bank stability. The cold, clean water from headwater streams helps keep rivers cool for fish and other aquatic life during the warm summer months.
**[At Monte Rio Redwoods, everything is connected.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680909/548676298/930498260?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&ms=MonteRio5_Link1&sourceid=1166936&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)** People, forests, and water work in tandem. By protecting these headwaters, we are working to nurture thriving redwood forests and vital habitats for native plants and wildlife.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680910/548676299/2018652235?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&ms=MonteRio5_Image2&sourceid=1166936&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
_Photo by Justin Lewis_
Every living being—humans included—depends on clean water to survive. And that starts with healthy headwaters.
Our actions today to safeguard the streams and headwaters of Monte Rio Redwoods will positively impact the health of rivers, wildlife, and people. Here and now, near and far, and generations into the future. [**That is something worth conserving!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108680911/548676300/2018652235?contactdata=4VM1c169GEpjitJypndKCUZF/ET+bhO1V/u99fTkl8uDc8kxyTwi5azJ/MYjT/Xo0SrqcXV74VDuDc+HlY5lnGx97D3q6955h2g30MV6eGdY6azmnCCcvLHg007QYU4ohSFcqPrfbmYn5Tgp6TrdV5+UfGnOnnZkz91BysUEFNs=&ms=MonteRio5_Link2&sourceid=1166936&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZiNzA1YjNmLTkyM2QtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Eueja8pHTy-R7QjLeWL4KqcFbEsFkaWyagYmOMkLRS0=&emci=a54b0e0d-9f3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=fb705b3f-923d-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
With gratitude,
| Laura Lalemand
Senior Scientist

name: Lizzie Fletcher
subject: It’s been a challenging month
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/Non-Re-Elect%20Logo.png]
Last week, late Wednesday night through the early hours of the morning Thursday, while most of the country was asleep, House Republicans passed their big ugly budget bill through the House of Representatives. With more than 1,000 pages and only a few hours to review them, House Republicans, with an assist from President Trump, worked through the dead of night to jam one of the most consequential and disastrous bills in memory through the House.
The bill is not fiscally responsible. It grows deficit spending and adds trillions to our national debt over the next 10 years. The bill is not morally defensible. It takes from the poor to give tax cuts to the rich.
House Democrats fought back, in committees—in mine, we pulled an all-nighter the week before in a 26 hour markup of some of this big budget bill’s provisions—in the Rules committee, and on the floor. In the end, the vote was 215-214-1. And now it is on to the Senate, which will make its own changes and send it back to the House.
So, we can’t give up. We will continue to fight the provisions in this bill that are so devastating—like kicking eligible Americans off Medicaid, eliminating tax credits that make health insurance more affordable, defunding Planned Parenthood, taking away food assistance and more. We will work in all the ways we can to make sure people know that this bill will hurt communities across the country, and we are trying to defeat it. The odds aren’t in our favor, but we won’t stop trying.
Last week, after the vote, I got a text from a dear friend with a photo and flashback from seven years ago. To the May night in 2018 that we won the Democratic primary runoff for TX-07. We did so through the collective efforts of a broad coalition of people that knew the stakes, did the work, and believed in the promise.
Six months later, in November 2018, Democrats won back the House majority—and we made history together as I became the first Democrat in more than 50 years and the first woman ever elected to represent our district in Congress. It wasn’t easy. It wasn’t guaranteed. In fact, many people told me it wasn’t possible to win. But we did.
Since then, we’ve faced historic challenges. But we’ve also shown what’s possible when we work together. Time and again, we’ve seen that making progress depends on all of us.
This month has provided so many more stark reminders of what’s at stake in our country right now. And why our work—your work—matters. If you’re in a position to make a contribution before the May end-of-month fundraising deadline tomorrow night, your support will help us not just to hold this seat, but to help take back the House in 2026. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250530?refcode=lpfe250530]
If this month has shown us anything, it’s that Democrats must take back the House. And if our TX07 races in 2018 and after show us anything, it’s that we can.
Together, we can do anything,
Lizzie Signature [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie_signature-1.png]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe250530?refcode=lpfe250530]

name: Charlie Kirk, Turning Point USA
subject: We were never supposed to be winning...
body:
From one spark to a nationwide fire.

[Unsubscribe](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj2051resyvl5ehg98pswwugu6z75wtbcfnv1f8czc5bz5nnstfw5gs7fmp03urzkqyw7f8qq62410byrj4ps&__stmp=sx3dt3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
| | | [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtpls785nd9baj8vyccwnw7sbvbk5ru1tz66ls97kls7n8r6sj17ukf71ixaam4s55c0782w6zj00rf2bzqj64gu9ponkn5c1metrxioqhendmcvdlcy659nghvpjieq4gjdvjk0gyzh45qj55mww75b9bk0cqy4nj3cjjm94ny3duabjsc2gqthk4anp30bh49iya18s805lzzw8bp9xu86x29oiobfpgjclu2wtwvb4gud084e3kon8yhvk3wfif5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx3dt3&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, We recently wrapped up one of Turning Point USA's latest stops on the American Comeback Tour at UC San Diego... I wish you could have been there to see it. Another packed quad. Students eager to listen. Flags waving. Cheers for America. Energy you could feel in your bones. _Not in Texas... Not in Florida..._ **_California._** The "Deep Blue" stronghold the Left said we'd never touch. But we did. And we'll keep going. **Because of patriots like you.**
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=clt64yr0wtpls785nd9baj8vyccwnw7sbx7zlug7zji27c2bphtojvrmq1r2ejtwxsog60csfv3hi4vroemicwb21ora6mjcn2b9wqsqrycrndgl8v5b3mcdfqr85j7olb36gbefuy7nag8xg0f4engog2rvowlpvj1kj4sfemlgitcdx514vxbox0iqntzzv8vv376loq6wdntxg72p7r151gvmwo41r8lhe9e4cqdcaumbhh4iys9cjst5o8nq7q7u0t412xa&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sx3dt3&__onlt=h)
---
As I stood there looking out at the crowd — hundreds of young patriots rising up in a place the Left said they owned — I couldn't help but think... **Nearly 13 years ago, all of this felt...****_impossible._** Back then, Turning Point USA wasn't the cultural phenomenon it is today. It wasn't an office. It wasn't a team. _It was just me._ No money. No connections. Just a desk and an old computer in a dusty garage in the Chicago suburbs. _But what I did have was a vision..._ It was 2012. The Left controlled every classroom, every campus, and nearly every corner of our culture. Their narrative was everywhere: America was evil... Faith was "oppressive"... Freedom was outdated... The Conservative movement was dead... _And most of all, young people belonged to the Left._ **I didn't believe that. I couldn't accept that. I couldn't just stand by and watch the Left win.** Back then, it was no wonder WHY we were losing young people to the Left... The Conservative movement felt stale... Conservative organizations felt like a snooze... And it felt like no one had an idea of how to reach America's youth... I believed if we were ever going to win young people back for America, we needed excitement. Energy. Passion. And ZEAL for our ideas. **My dream was to launch a conservative youth movement that would inspire young people to stand for truth — and LOVE this country again.** I didn't know what I was going to call this dream... this feeling... this movement. So, I picked up the phone, called my dad, and said, "I think I'm supposed to start something, but I don't have a name for it..." **He replied...****_"How about Turning Point?"_** And just like that, a fire was lit. Turning Point USA was born. On the promise that we could TURN this country around, one young heart at a time. The early days were brutal. I remember driving across the Chicago suburbs to small Tea Party meetings talking about "generational theft"... I remember my first Turning Point USA speaking event in Peoria, Illinois during the summer of 2012, where just six people showed up... **And I remember the look in their eyes — those early patriots —****when I told them the vision:** _"We're going to create a youth movement that LOVES America."_ _"We're going to go on campus and win hearts and minds."_ _"We're going to push back — and we're going to WIN."_ They didn't laugh... They didn't walk out... **They believed. And Friend — so did patriots like you.**
---
You see, this isn't my story. This is YOUR story. Because without patriots like you... _there is no Turning Point USA._ Without you... _there is no American Comeback story._ Without you... _there is no cultural shift happening right now in schools, churches, homes, and on every campus across our great nation._ You were there when the campus quads and halls were empty... stood by us when our signs got torn down. You had our backs when the mob showed up — when they shouted, screamed, and tried to wipe us off the map. **You didn't give up. And neither did we.** But we were never supposed to be winning... The Left thought they owned this generation. They thought their indoctrination had worked. _But they were wrong._ I remember standing at tables on hostile campuses with nothing but flyers and hope, praying to have a conversation that would light a spark. I went where I was told a young conservative didn't belong. And I kept going back.

Friend, Gov. Ron DeSantis just threw his support behind expanding one of the strongest immigration enforcement tools Florida has: **E-Verify.** **Last year, Gov. Ron DeSantis signed Senate Bill 1718 into law, requiring private employers with 25 or more employees to verify the legal status of every new hire**. Since then, Florida has ranked _**NUMBER ONE**_ in the country in E-Verify usage. * **TOP NEWS**

"**SpaceX found some success, and some failure, on ninth Starship flight test from Texas,** " Houston Chronicle's **Andrea Leinfelder** - "SpaceX launched its [ninth Starship flight test](https://substack.com/redirect/0e3ec23b-39c3-4a6a-b161-1bd992cf777c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday evening, successfully completing milestones such as flying a previously flown booster, but falling short of the test's full goals.

The Super Heavy rocket and Starship spacecraft, collectively called Starship, launched from South Texas a little after 6:30 p.m.

Lift off and vehicle separation went as expected. SpaceX was not planning to catch the booster, most of which had previously flown on the seventh flight test, and was instead attempting to collect data with a more aggressive landing in the Gulf of Mexico when Super Heavy exploded.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/ac8d25d7-e34a-4430-8d41-684c75fcca4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Starship completed its ascent and went significantly farther than the past two tests, which exploded while climbing into space, but SpaceX lost control of its orientation. The spacecraft also ended with an explosion before landing in the Indian Ocean.

"Starship made it to the scheduled ship engine cutoff, so big improvement over last flight!" SpaceX founder **Elon Musk** said on X.

"Also, no significant loss of heat shield tiles during ascent. Leaks caused loss of main tank pressure during the coast and re-entry phase. Lot of good data to review," Musk added.

He pledged that the next three flights would have faster turnarounds, with a launch every three to four weeks. The company just received regulatory approval to launch [up to 25 times a year](https://substack.com/redirect/64289c0a-a25a-4d7f-ac95-fd3bf00262db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from Starbase, Texas.

Musk was supposed to give an update on the company after the Starship flight test, but it was unclear if he would still speak as of 8:30 p.m." [Hou Chron](https://substack.com/redirect/aa1c13bd-d30c-45b1-ba27-1eeb231b1c95?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

The Super Heavy rocket and Starship spacecraft, collectively called Starship, launched from South Texas a little after 6:30 p.m. Lift off and vehicle separation went as expected. SpaceX was not planning to catch the booster, most of which had previously flown on the seventh flight test, and was instead attempting to collect data with a more aggressive landing in the Gulf of Mexico when Super Heavy exploded. Starship completed its ascent and went significantly farther than the past two tests, which exploded while climbing into space, but SpaceX lost control of its orientation. The spacecraft also ended with an explosion before landing in the Indian Ocean. "Starship made it to the scheduled ship engine cutoff, so big improvement over last flight!" SpaceX founder Elon Musk said on X. "Also, no significant loss of heat shield tiles during ascent. Leaks caused loss of main tank pressure during the coast and re-entry phase. Lot of good data to review," Musk added. He pledged that the next three flights would have faster turnarounds, with a launch every three to four weeks. "This is absurd!"
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/821be841-09d6-4561-8543-d73efedbfdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/821be841-09d6-4561-8543-d73efedbfdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Is this administration committed to following the court rulings and the legal process?" Pamela Brown asked Miller.
Miller assured her that the administration has complied with "all court orders" but that certain activist judges have far surpassed their authority to influence the president's directives. "It completely upends the constitutional system!" he exclaimed.
**["The Democrat party is waging war against democracy,](https://substack.com/redirect/821be841-09d6-4561-8543-d73efedbfdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** they should be call the Communist party!" Miller went off at Brown, who tried contain his answer to no avail. "Next question!"
Brown pressed Miller over whether the White House is planning to suspend Habeas Corpus to circumvent judicial blocks and carry out further deportations of illegal migrants. Miller reminded her that the government has the authority to do so during a time on invasion.
**[After a frustrating back and forth, Miller exploded,](https://substack.com/redirect/821be841-09d6-4561-8543-d73efedbfdb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "Is it really your belief, because if it is that's breathtaking to me, that when we're deporting an illegal alien that we need to get permission from an Article 3 district court judge?! Like a trial judge? Is that your view?!!"

# Megyn Kelly CONFRONTS Jake Tapper for years of false reporting on Biden:
## "There was a coverup... you allowed it!!"
Megyn Kelly **[tore CNN's Jake Tapper a new one](https://substack.com/redirect/9830bddb-d450-4024-9390-7d2aa5ec61e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** live on her podcast for knowingly "covering up" President Joe Biden's mental decline and failing to report the truth to the American people.
She called him out directly to his face, "Jake, I feel angry!"
[Watch The Video](https://substack.com/redirect/9830bddb-d450-4024-9390-7d2aa5ec61e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9830bddb-d450-4024-9390-7d2aa5ec61e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Megyn Kelly showed no mercy to the longtime CNN host during the hard-hitting the interview, especially after he went on a monologue trying to defend the thoroughness of his reporting on Biden's health.
"I did ask Joe Biden to be transparent about his health records in 2020," Tapper said.
"You didn't ask him about it. You didn't follow-up that he was falling up the stairs. That he was losing his train of thought regularly, that he was slurring, that he was incomprehensible, that he was getting lost on the White House lawn," Kelly spewed. "You sat right across from him and you asked none of that."
Tapper meekly replied, "That's right I didn't."
**[Kelly then played a clip from CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/9830bddb-d450-4024-9390-7d2aa5ec61e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** where tapper spoke to Lara Trump, where instead of letting her speak, he scolded her for daring to make any statements about Biden's clear aging cognitive decline.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/39da906c-8c93-43a6-a966-eccdd5006ea7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"When I watch that clip - and I'm giving voice to what a lot of people are feeling, Jake - I feel angry because she was right, and not only did you not allow her to make her comments, but you seemed to try to humiliate her. You had hostility toward the position. She was totally right, and then you lectured her about how she was in no position to diagnose cognitive decline, which you guys do at length," Kelly said.
Tapper admitted to his wrongful treatment of Lara Trump, "Her comments have aged well. My comments have aged poorly. I own that, but what I think is significant is, beyond just me owning that, the reporting that Alex and I have done,... Joe Biden has been saying stupid things for decades."
**[Kelly wasn't satisfied yet,](https://substack.com/redirect/9830bddb-d450-4024-9390-7d2aa5ec61e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** again pressing Tapper on his extensive history of false reporting though Biden's tenure, "It wasn't just falling down. It was getting lost. Some of the stuff you report in your book, we knew and we were reporting on. Like the multi jump cuts in the videos of him where it was obvious he couldn't get through a one minute take so they had to use those...all of which the White House was denying."
"You've been in DC thirty years, Jake, you and CNN have White House connections, but there was no effort. None to get to the bottom of this, and now for you guys to write this book like 'there was a cover up' it's like - there was a cover up, an attempted cover up. It could only ever work if you allowed it," Kelly added.
Watch the combative exchange from Megyn Kelly's show here:

| | Peter –

While Marie continues to deliver solutions for Southwest Washington families in Congress, we have a big fight looming for our campaign. Here’s where we’re at:
* The NRCC named Marie as one of their **top targets to defeat** this cycle, and Roll Call named her as one of the 10 **most vulnerable House Democrats**.
* **Millions of dollars in attack ads** and outside spending are already pouring into our district.

Joni Ernst, Iowa's resident bootstraps enthusiast and insurance industry mascot, responded to concerns about gutting Medicaid with a casual shrug and the line, "We're all going to die." That wasn't a nihilist poet on an absinthe bender, but **a U.S. Senator justifying ripping health care from poor people and: Letting. Them. Die.**
Joni offered the "let 'em die and God sort it out" rhetoric quite casually, like it was a mildly inconvenient budget line. Like how she made her sexual assault in the military, and protecting other women from the same, a key talking point in her U.S. Senate election. Only to casually decide a few years later to vote for human bobblehead Pete Hegseth as Secretary of Defense. A guy out of a _Girls Gone Wild_ video who'd settled a civil suit with a woman who alleged he assaulted her, and whose _own mother_ thought he was such a woman-abusing, dick-in-a-box she wrote a letter berating him for it.
This is your Joni Ernst. This is your Joni Ernst on MAGA. Any questions?
No? Good. Now, back to letting Americans--humans--die from preventable disease or injury just because you're a fucking Republican ghoul. Sorry, no nicer way to say this, folks. It isn't policy--it's cruelty lacquered in faux, folksy Fox indifference. Because, MAGA's a brain disease ever-mutating into something far worse, like watching a common cold transition into Ebola.

body:
I hear a lot of people tell me they’re losing hope these days, and I understand why. It feels like Trump’s winning.
#

Peter —
We’ve got a deadline tomorrow night, at midnight. And before that hits, I’m hoping you might be able to chip in and help me hit my fundraising goal for May.
Here’s why: I hear a lot of people tell me they’re losing hope these days, and I understand why. It feels like Trump’s winning. But for me, I’ve never had much more than hope.
Hope as a kid growing up poor, looking for a way to help my family, to get out of that situation. Hope as a Marine in Iraq, watching my friends get wounded and killed, just trying to get home. Hope as a veteran, that I’d be able to get the help me and my brothers needed after we came home.
None of those things came without work, without effort. It was not easy. But they took a lot of hope, too.
And I’ve still got hope. Hope for my son, for my daughter. Hope for the baby Sydney and I have coming soon. I can’t give up, and I refuse to lose hope.
Donations to emails like these are the main way we cover the cost of the work we’re doing.
And with a new baby on the way, I’m going to be relying on emails like these more than ever. I’m taking time off to be a dad, and I won’t be able to do fundraisers or phone calls.
So, before that happens, I’m really hoping you could chip in so we can make up for the shortfall. It would mean a lot to me to have that peace of mind.
[**Please, if you can afford it, chip in $5 or whatever amount feels right for you and help us crush our goals before our deadline at midnight tomorrow.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-may25.XT1Xme&refcode=em250530-1-b&t=31&akid=3878%2E734936%2Ey_g5D1)

clean_body: Folks, Before Roe v. Wade was overturned, I made it a priority to protect women’s reproductive rights in New Mexico. And after Roe was overturned, I watched with you as nearly half of all states in the U.S. instated or attempted to instate severe restrictions on abortion access. That’s had an impact even in New Mexico, where providers are treating folks from here AND those fleeing nearby states for care. The challenges have only intensified with Donald Trump in the White House. Following the Project 2025 blueprint, Trump is attempting to use an archaic 1873 law called the Comstock Act to drastically limit abortion access nationwide. I co-sponsored the Stop Comstock Act to ensure women can continue to access reproductive health care, and I’ll do everything in my power to protect access to abortion care and ensure no one is forced into government-mandated pregnancy. Fellow Conservative, four decades ago, I joined the Atlanta Police Department as a beat cop.

My first assignment was walking high crime foot patrol on Auburn Avenue. Eventually, I became chief of police in Doraville, a small community northeast of Atlanta. During my career in law enforcement, I locked up drug dealers, arrested and deported criminals here illegally, and did everything I could to keep the community safe.

**I have some scars to show for it: I was shot and stabbed in the line of duty.**

That didn’t break me; it strengthened my resolve. During my career as a law enforcement officer, I busted criminals, yes, but I also built bridges with diverse communities and saw neighbors helping neighbors.

**I know how important it is to support law enforcement and first responders.

Soft-on-crime policies and weak leadership make our communities less safe. In the Senate, I’ll always Back the Blue and work with President Trump to make our country safer and more secure.**

[**But I can’t do it without your support.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=c5c93683bbae456ea6c34313fa0298c6&_e=MXA6-GJ7k_mImjCaXzmfl64CNifEGDr0hu5BKy1WocTWvICcRabYi6WKzng0f2Cej7HfLTVMgBAdvLeZ72bKtWsSW4rW5liUvgH3leTo0DA7aBgU2VDHf8nb5aKXrHUIseelT39SCc4gQC5T8ExoCfbQVbQK2Wa7TpbwyrHrpfKQjuu4KooYkRLqtt1HZi-zWiXlepK1UWD50-_CUjHqWuxYasL1ba06Nr8L_bbtIAb9SiP-dFdSEF3LrTZFKVGhH9IB4EWjXgCxrHUocyrhZfIX1U3dpozPHoSqpOvbaCKDIlPqdXcepVQitjHGTROQYMH1vs_cw22CBwq5JHzTvCT-2nb0DsH9yypZ88MKoM4vtfFspEM42Ch77oMk7zTgb__HFEyvy1cntOLxwV_pww%3D%3D)

When it comes to supporting law enforcement, Jon Ossoff has been totally AWOL. He refuses to call out his own party’s insane anti-police policies, and he refused to speak up when __**"Cop City"**__ protesters threatened Atlanta’s police training center.

He must be defeated.

clean_body: During my career in law enforcement, I locked up drug dealers, arrested and deported criminals here illegally, and did everything I could to keep the community safe. | Fellow Conservative, four decades ago, I joined the Atlanta Police Department as a beat cop. My first assignment was walking high crime foot patrol on Auburn Avenue. Eventually, I became chief of police in Doraville, a small community northeast of Atlanta. During my career in law enforcement, I locked up drug dealers, arrested and deported criminals here illegally, and did everything I could to keep the community safe. I have some scars to show for it: I was shot and stabbed in the line of duty. That didn’t break me; it strengthened my resolve. During my career as a law enforcement officer, I busted criminals, yes, but I also built bridges with diverse communities and saw neighbors helping neighbors. I know how important it is to support law enforcement and first responders. Soft-on-crime policies and weak leadership make our communities less safe. In the Senate, I’ll always Back the Blue and work with President Trump to make our country safer and more secure. When it comes to supporting law enforcement, Jon Ossoff has been totally AWOL. He refuses to call out his own party’s insane anti-police policies, and he refused to speak up when "Cop City" protesters threatened Atlanta’s police training center. He must be defeated. I started my career as a beat cop and became a police chief. I know bullets and budgets, and I’m ready to fight for you in the Senate. Let’s win this together. Thank you, Maj. Gen. President Trump has worked with the McLaughlin brothers since 2011 before he ever ran for president. Jim and John McLaughlin have provided accurate, reliable polling for years and for the first time ever, we have both of them on the show. McLaughlin & Associates have a brand new national survey for May 2025 and pinpoint battleground data for House Republicans to win the 2026 midterms. When President Trump was elected 63% of sampled voters said we were on the wrong track. The president has drastically improved that number to get us back on the right track as a nation. President Trump came back from the Middle East with Trillions of dollars in investments in the United States. It created a historic alliance that embodied the idea of peace through strength. President Trump's policies made him the most popular candidate in 2024 and keeping his word with promises made, promises kept keep adding to his favorability. The Biden hangover has not subsided in voters minds as Joe Biden only has a 40% favorability and Kamala Harris at 45%. Democrats overall don't not have a single candidate that is favorable in voters minds. Looking ahead to House 2026 midterm races, the McLaughlin brothers have brand new data on the winning issues and the path to victory for House Republicans.

body:
Running for office is tough. That’s why we’re investing in real support — and we need your help to keep going. |
#
---
Team — You’ve heard us talk about building a new generation of leadership. _But what does that actually take?_ It takes digital ads that reach people who’ve never even considered running and helps them see themselves as candidates. It takes grassroots organizing that shows up in neighborhoods, college campuses, and union halls. It takes staff, strategy, training, and time. **All the pieces that turn potential into power.** Fight Like Hell PAC is doing that work every day. #
Friend of Life, it’s Lila Rose - Founder and President of Live Action. I have an urgent request.

Walgreens and CVS will begin selling the lethal abortion pill with a prescription this month.

This means that in pro-abortion states like California, Illinois, and Connecticut, a teen with a doctor's note can receive the deadly abortion pill in her local pharmacy, all without her parent's knowledge. Expansion of the abortion pill into local pharmacies has already killed tens of thousands of preborn children.

The U.S. Supreme Court will soon hear the most important pro-life case since overturning Roe v. Wade. The Court will decide whether dangerous telemedicine abortions and the distribution of abortion pills by mail and pharmacies can continue nationwide.

We need to raise our voices now while there is still time. I’m looking for 100 people to give before midnight. Can you be one of them?

You will mobilize parents, grandparents, and pro-life people with the truth by donating right now. No other pro-life organization has the online reach we do. That’s why your gift of $50 before midnight will alert more than 1700 people about this agenda of death. Give now using this secure link:

For Life,

Hi Peter,

When a woman this morning begged for her neighbors' lives, Iowa Sen. Joni Ernst didn't offer compassion. She offered a punchline: **_" Well, we're all going to die."_** That was her response to a desperate warning that Trump's new budget cuts to Medicaid would kill people. Just a shoulder-shrug to the idea that our friends, family and neighbors might lose care and die. That's what we're up against now. A political movement so callous that death isn't a consequence, it's collateral. It's baked in. And I want you to think about this: **_what does it say when a Democrat votes with that same movement?_** **Because my opponent, Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, has backed that agenda over and over again.** She voted for a defense bill that stripped reproductive care from servicewomen. She supported a MAGA immigration bill Trump is now using to justify sweeping, violent deportations. She even helped censure civil rights leader Al Green who stood up for our health care rights. You don't have to say _" we're all going to die" _to show you've given up on people. **You just have to vote like it.** What does bipartisanship even mean--when one party is gutting health care, civil rights, and deporting people to foreign slave camps? At some point, you have to wonder: why is our Democratic representative still chasing compromise with fascists? This isn't a difference of opinion--it's a moral collapse. **And any Democrat who thinks we can meet that evil halfway has already lost the plot.** If we win the House next year--and I believe we can--it won't be enough to just stop Trump's next move. We'll need the spine to reverse this cruelty. To fund Medicaid. To protect abortion access. To govern like working people matter. We can't do that if Democrats in name only are voting with MAGA.
**I 've buried a daughter, nearly lost my wife, and know exactly what it's like to rely on health care that politicians treat like a bargaining chip.** [**If you believe our politics should serve people --not punish them--please chip in today and help us win this fight.**](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqv6r8GR7zKbLdKY8JcRsBH8aQhQzL-6XFLiJ1IzrYZqHcVu3_2xEWSSvdjjDmkiSUBKNNuxCfDyj4KiVyeQHccumnUEU701xNy6nGerWYK2PGra7uOQCujQmRoIlQNBuFRy-mVRwJtrkGHsH2fvZj2LfiZiFDO0h871s97su_jdlr8HV1myOr8DOxh61p5czPmZz4nN-eDSmFKk6pXbzy4Inm8CvCUIVlIxoY4BcW4oaiK6xkQ0yaYTcJZOso82-BO1hsNTpe7POUbbQ6whK3iBWfYGzLE48ArAN_zHjISMl9H8YBffyXwVubh6N8Gprpl0RI9XjBqgO5EZtq0C2pZF_TqdkX_dI7D4vUVI_wzFuT2maDsMnDMjCjyy9L-Ex-c/4gx/_bt3Gc7DRrys2qYNtOsG_A/h1/h001.Td7ahvvb6YQ5kSWP5RJ1WU3H9F8_0sKGOYcShYT2tG0)

clean_body: | | Hi Peter, When a woman this morning begged for her neighbors' lives, Iowa Sen. Joni Ernst didn't offer compassion. She offered a punchline: " Well, we're all going to die." That was her response to a desperate warning that Trump's new budget cuts to Medicaid would kill people. Just a shoulder-shrug to the idea that our friends, family and neighbors might lose care and die. That's what we're up against now. A political movement so callous that death isn't a consequence, it's collateral. It's baked in. And I want you to think about this: what does it say when a Democrat votes with that same movement? Because my opponent, Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, has backed that agenda over and over again. She voted for a defense bill that stripped reproductive care from servicewomen. She supported a MAGA immigration bill Trump is now using to justify sweeping, violent deportations. She even helped censure civil rights leader Al Green who stood up for our health care rights. You don't have to say " we're all going to die" to show you've given up on people. You just have to vote like it. What does bipartisanship even mean--when one party is gutting health care, civil rights, and deporting people to foreign slave camps? At some point, you have to wonder: why is our Democratic representative still chasing compromise with fascists? This isn't a difference of opinion--it's a moral collapse. And any Democrat who thinks we can meet that evil halfway has already lost the plot. If we win the House next year--and I believe we can--it won't be enough to just stop Trump's next move. We'll need the spine to reverse this cruelty. To fund Medicaid. To protect abortion access. To govern like working people matter. We can't do that if Democrats in name only are voting with MAGA. I 've buried a daughter, nearly lost my wife, and know exactly what it's like to rely on health care that politicians treat like a bargaining chip. Let's Heal Washington! body:
#

_Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state Trump won in 2024.
And this Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– please rush $5 to my re-election campaign today.
**Here’s the link to donate:**[**https://act.electjon.com/go/donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may25.ZUBy2n&refcode=em250530-2&t=1&akid=397%2E5691347%2EJKenCN)
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history. In his first 100 days:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists—and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.
* Handed sweeping, unaccountable power to the billionaire who spent $300 million to elect him.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history—and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please make a contribution to my re-election campaign today, of $5 or any amount that works for you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may25.ZUBy2n&refcode=em250530-2&t=2&akid=397%2E5691347%2EJKenCN)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may25.ZUBy2n&refcode=em250530-2&t=3&akid=397%2E5691347%2EJKenCN)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
As always,
Jon Ossoff
[

| | When I first heard that a book I wrote was one of hundreds banned from the U.S. Naval Academy library under the Trump regime, I found the news incredibly concerning. You see, my book — _Our Time Is Now_ — chronicles the erosion of voting rights, highlights the far right’s attacks on democracy, and provides a blueprint for ending voter suppression and empowering our fellow citizens to uphold and expand free and fair elections. And if the far right actually believes that my book about ensuring democracy is a threat to their ability to destroy it, then I’m on to something. In addition, I’m proud to be in the company of authors like Dr. Carol Anderson, a renowned historian and professor of African American studies who serves on the Board of Directors for Fair Fight Action. Her book _White Rage: The Unspoken Truth Of Our Racial Divide_ was also banned. It won the National Book Critics Circle Award for criticism, and it analyzes the struggle for Black Americans to be full participants in our democracy. Of course, the ultimate target of book bans like these is the power that we, the people, possess. The power that MAGA Republicans would suppress. The power that we must use. **With our freedoms facing grave threats, and with people in power trying to keep us from understanding how to defend it, we must double down in our fight for democracy.** **And we must support groups like Fair Fight that do the vital work of making our democracy live up to its promise, tackling the rise of authoritarianism, and ensuring free and fair elections.** [**That’s why I need to ask if you can make a donation of any amount to Fair Fight. Every contribution helps make sure they can combat voter suppression in this new Trump era and help build a democracy where every voice is heard and empowered.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108687668/548696477/1297451850?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250530_f_SYAEOM_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2ZkYTRiNC1hMzNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MyshaRwNpmybhoi-aSKufuUlucsjNW_B2NGlkEwFnA0=) | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108687669/548696480/1297451850?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20250530_f_SYAEOM_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2ZkYTRiNC1hMzNkLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MyshaRwNpmybhoi-aSKufuUlucsjNW_B2NGlkEwFnA0=)

Let’s be clear: You ban books if you’re afraid of the knowledge they can provide and the questions they may inspire readers to ask.
And you suppress the vote if you’re afraid you could not win a truly fair election — or if you believe some people are inherently unworthy of participating in our democracy.
My book was banned alongside works of literature and scholarship by people like Maya Angelou and Ibram X. Kendi.
Mind you, they did not ban _Mein Kampf_ , by Adolf Hitler.
The targeted books are about topics like race, gender, and public policy, and they fall under MAGA’s attack on DEI — also known as “diversity, equity, and inclusion”; also known as the basis for all the movements of progress and opportunity we’ve achieved as a nation.
**Moves like these reveal the Trump regime’s outright contempt for civil rights and the ability of women, people of color, and marginalized communities to be part of American life. And as they continue working to suppress our voices, we must keep on fighting back.**
**I’m proud that Fair Fight stands strong against attacks on our democracy.**
I founded Fair Fight after the 2018 elections to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate and the presidency.
Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, preventing mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism.
But none of this work is possible without dedicated supporters like you.

clean_body: I need to ask if you can make a donation to fight for our freedoms and democracy. | | | When I first heard that a book I wrote was one of hundreds banned from the U.S. Naval Academy library under the Trump regime, I found the news incredibly concerning. You see, my book — Our Time Is Now — chronicles the erosion of voting rights, highlights the far right’s attacks on democracy, and provides a blueprint for ending voter suppression and empowering our fellow citizens to uphold and expand free and fair elections. And if the far right actually believes that my book about ensuring democracy is a threat to their ability to destroy it, then I’m on to something. In addition, I’m proud to be in the company of authors like Dr. Carol Anderson, a renowned historian and professor of African American studies who serves on the Board of Directors for Fair Fight Action. Her book White Rage: The Unspoken Truth Of Our Racial Divide was also banned. It won the National Book Critics Circle Award for criticism, and it analyzes the struggle for Black Americans to be full participants in our democracy. Of course, the ultimate target of book bans like these is the power that we, the people, possess. The power that MAGA Republicans would suppress. The power that we must use. With our freedoms facing grave threats, and with people in power trying to keep us from understanding how to defend it, we must double down in our fight for democracy. And we must support groups like Fair Fight that do the vital work of making our democracy live up to its promise, tackling the rise of authoritarianism, and ensuring free and fair elections. = | = Let’s be clear: You ban books if you’re afraid of the knowledge they can provide and the questions they may inspire readers to ask. And you suppress the vote if you’re afraid you could not win a truly fair election — or if you believe some people are inherently unworthy of participating in our democracy. My book was banned alongside works of literature and scholarship by people like Maya Angelou and Ibram X. Kendi. Mind you, they did not ban Mein Kampf , by Adolf Hitler. The targeted books are about topics like race, gender, and public policy, and they fall under MAGA’s attack on DEI — also known as “diversity, equity, and inclusion”; also known as the basis for all the movements of progress and opportunity we’ve achieved as a nation. Moves like these reveal the Trump regime’s outright contempt for civil rights and the ability of women, people of color, and marginalized communities to be part of American life. And as they continue working to suppress our voices, we must keep on fighting back. I’m proud that Fair Fight stands strong against attacks on our democracy. I founded Fair Fight after the 2018 elections to help make sure every eligible voter can easily register to vote, cast their ballot, and have it counted. Since its founding, Fair Fight has successfully combated voter suppression, made it possible for more people to exercise their power and their voice at the ballot box, and helped elect pro-democracy champions from municipal governments to the U.S. Senate and the presidency. Fair Fight will continue building pro-voter political power in the South, expanding access to voting, preventing mass voter purges, and pioneering strategic analysis and innovation to counter rising authoritarianism. US. Sens. Katie Britt, R-Alabama; Cindy Hyde-Smith, R-Mississippi; Roger Marshall, R-Kansas; and Senate Agriculture Committee Chairman John Boozman, R-Arkansas, on Wednesday introduced S.1919, the Buying American Cotton Act, legislation that incentivizes the consumption of products made with U.S. cotton. “It’s imperative we champion American-made cotton produced in our Cotton Belt states, like Alabama. This legislative effort reinforces my commitment to our cotton growers and ginners by incentivizing the purchase of U.S. cotton and by combating the illegal market practices our adversaries implement to gain a competitive advantage,” Britt said. “I’m proud to join my colleagues in supporting this critical industry to produce even more high-quality, Made in America cotton.”

U.S. Senators Katie Britt and John Fetterman (D-Pa.) have reintroduced the Stop the Scroll Act during Mental Health Awareness Month, aiming to raise awareness about the mental health effects of social media usage. The bipartisan legislation would require a mental health warning label on social media platforms and provide users with access to mental health resources.

The bill responds to a recommendation by the U.S. Surgeon General last year, which called for warning labels similar to those seen on tobacco products. If enacted, the legislation would direct the Surgeon General to develop the label, while the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) would oversee its implementation.

So the Republican plan is to gut Medicaid to defund Planned Parenthood – and it'll rip away millions of people's ability to get affordable checkups, cancer treatments, and lifesaving reproductive care.

**Defunding Planned Parenthood means defunding basic health care.**
Peter, Americans have made it clear time and again that they do not want politicians interfering in their health care.

And it's pretty simple: Steadfast commitment to speaking out like you have eventually leads to the wins we need. Look, I've beaten back Republican attacks on reproductive rights before. The last time Republicans tried to defund Planned Parenthood, they _FAILED – I personally made sure of that_.

clean_body: | | | Peter, we're almost to the end of the month, but I can't say the same about our progress toward our monthly fundraising goal. = = There is no low Republicans won't sink to if it means getting Donald Trump his $4.5 trillion in tax cuts for billionaires. Not only does that include kicking nearly 14 million Americans off their health insurance, but Republicans are also trying to sneak in a provision to DEFUND Planned Parenthood. More than half of Planned Parenthood's patients use Medicaid and related programs, funds which are already ineligible to cover abortion care. Whether it’s cancer screenings or getting birth control, for many, Planned Parenthood is their only option for affordable health care near home. So the Republican plan is to gut Medicaid to defund Planned Parenthood – and it'll rip away millions of people's ability to get affordable checkups, cancer treatments, and lifesaving reproductive care. Defunding Planned Parenthood means defunding basic health care. Peter, Americans have made it clear time and again that they do not want politicians interfering in their health care. And it's pretty simple: Steadfast commitment to speaking out like you have eventually leads to the wins we need. Look, I've beaten back Republican attacks on reproductive rights before. The last time Republicans tried to defund Planned Parenthood, they FAILED – I personally made sure of that. So I need you to know that I'm going to keep fighting with everything I've got to stop them from succeeding this time. But I can't do it on my own. Meeting – or even surpassing – our fundraising goal would be an incredible show of strength to the GOP that we have what it takes to fight back. | Peter,

The Supreme Court is poised to decide on two cases that could drastically reshape our nation's commitment to equality and justice.

One case challenges the constitutional guarantee of birthright citizenship, threatening to deny citizenship to children born on U.S. soil based on their parents' immigration status. Another case could uphold bans on gender-affirming care for transgender youth, stripping away essential healthcare rights.
