When he got there, he saw a running car parked facing the wrong way on a one-way street. With his emergency lights on, James got out to investigate.That's when it happened. The suspect saw my husband, slammed on the gas, and drove straight at him.With only a split second to act, James drew his weapon and fired a single shot at the vehicle bearing down on him. It struck the suspect, who died instantly. James was shaken by the incident, but thankfully he was unhurt. He went home, certain he had done everything by the book. **So you can imagine our shock when James found out he was being charged with murder!** You see, James is white, and the suspect he shot was black. She knows what happened that night. She knows James was in a life-or-death situation. She knows that the charge should have been dropped years ago.Fani Willis just wants to make an example out of my husband - starting this Monday. Friend, for years we've been trapped in limbo. We've lost nearly all our friends, and we've even been forced to move because of the terrible lies the prosecutors have been spreading about my husband.By some miracle, we've been able to get by, but every day is difficult. As you can imagine after 9 years of prosecution, what's been truly overwhelming is the cost of James' legal defense. When we ran out of money, we had all but given up hope... **And then we got a call from Jason Johnson, the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund, or LELDF.** If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongfully-accused police officers like James. Ritchie is no stranger to the struggle and poverty that so many in the South Bronx experience. It’s _these_ hardships that have guided Ritchie his entire life and inspired his career as a public servant.

**Peter, my son was able to connect with and captivate New York families because he understands their struggles — _we lived them ourselves._**

But Peter, the very things I celebrate about my son — _his advocacy for working families, his levelheaded, common-sense, and progressive approach to politics, and his commitment to upholding our democracy_ — are the same things that make many of his Republican colleagues upset.

**It’s because of support from people like you, Peter, that Ritchie has withstood Republican vitriol and paved his unique path to Congress. I am so proud of my son, and I hope you are too.**

name: Team Bonta
subject: Everyone has a role to play.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROB BONTA FOR CALIFORNIA ATTORNEY GENERAL 2026 FPPC ID #145642
body:
We wanted to share some of Rob’s inspiring words for these graduates with you.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250530&t=1&akid=1811%2E1088799%2EpCF2xU)
Last week, Rob had the honor of giving the keynote address to the San Francisco State University graduating class of 2025 at Oracle Park.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250530?refcode=em20250530-1811&amount=5&refcode2=1811_1088799_pCF2xU&akid=1811%2E1088799%2EpCF2xU)
We wanted to share some of Rob’s inspiring words for these graduates with you, because they really apply to all of us. Before we do, **[can you pitch in any amount to help ensure we reach our fundraising goal before May ends?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250530?refcode=em20250530-1811&amount=5&refcode2=1811_1088799_pCF2xU&akid=1811%2E1088799%2EpCF2xU)**
As Rob told the class of 2025:
“This is a uniquely daunting time to enter the so-called real world. The price of everything from gas to groceries, housing to health care is going up. The climate crisis continues to heat up. Rights we’ve long relied on are being rolled back right before our eyes. People are being attacked for how they look, where they’re from, how they pray, who they love, and for daring to speak their truth. And our democracy — the very foundation our nation stands on — is being stress-tested. _It’s a lot._
I can imagine you might look at the problems around us and feel impatient for change. I’m with you. I share your impatience, and I encourage you: _harness it._
Folks love to say, “Young people are the leaders of tomorrow,” and while that is certainly true, it’s also true that you’re the leaders of today. You have a voice today. You don’t have to wait your turn or wait for permission — you have the power to make a difference now. Your age will only hold you back if you let it.
I’m here to call you to action. It’s my sincerest hope that each of you will answer in your own way. Across the nation, our rights, freedoms, and safety are under attack. **Now is not the time for silence or blind compliance. The stakes are too high. Everyone has a role to play in shaping the world we all deserve to live in.**
As California Attorney General, my role includes vigorously protecting our people, enforcing our laws, and taking action when anyone breaks them, including, yes, the President of the United States. It should not be too much to ask that the President follow the law and uphold the Constitution, and yet, in the last four months, I’ve already had to take President Trump to court 22 times because he has acted as if he’s above the law. He isn’t — no one is.
Now I ask you, what role can you play? None of you needs to do _everything_ , but I respectfully encourage all of you to do _something_. Something that makes our shared society fairer and stronger, something that helps fix a broken part of the world, something that you are passionate about that has personal meaning to you. If you don't have the answer today, that’s alright. Now is the time to find out.
The one unsolicited piece of advice I have for all of you is to stay engaged, be it following the news, joining a march, attending a community meeting, sharing opinions with friends, family members, and neighbors, or voting in every election. You have a vested interest in what happens in your community, your state, and your country. **Democracy is not a spectator sport, it is full-contact. It thrives on engagement and it dies with apathy and neglect, which means we need you in the game, not on the sidelines.”**
**[If the Attorney General has your support as he carries on the fight for justice and progress for all in California, consider giving $5 or whatever you can to fuel our campaign before tomorrow’s deadline. Every donation makes a difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250530?refcode=em20250530-1811&amount=5&refcode2=1811_1088799_pCF2xU&akid=1811%2E1088799%2EpCF2xU)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250530?refcode=em20250530-1811&amount=5&refcode2=1811_1088799_pCF2xU&akid=1811%2E1088799%2EpCF2xU)**
Thank you for all you do,
Team Bonta

body:
#
Since this is a grassroots campaign, I want to be transparent with you. Our fundraising hit an unexpected dip these last few days—it happens sometimes and I don’t want to alarm you. But, I want to take a moment to share why this is important.
Unlike most other House campaigns, we operate differently. We invest in community organizing year-round and full-time permanent staff who execute all aspects of this campaign.
The Trump trifecta has taken hold, and so too have their billionaire, right-wing donors.
In order to fight back through mass movement politics, we need the resources to bring even more people into this campaign and continue to sustain our operation even in the “off year.”
I don’t curry favor with billionaires or attend fancy cocktail fundraisers. This campaign is made possible by people like you, firstname. [If you can afford it, can I count on your support today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250530-2.oI369D&refcode=em20250530-8980-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8980%2E2526796%2E3QErqU)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250530-2.oI369D&refcode=em20250530-8980-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=8980%2E2526796%2E3QErqU)**
Just a few years ago, I was a waitress wiping down a bar. I am vividly familiar with the value of a hard earned dollar. I also don’t expect that every supporter will contribute to every email we send—that would be way too much!
When thousands of people come together to chip in, it all adds up and allows me to focus on legislating, and not worry about checking in with my campaign manager about our fundraising numbers.
**If you are in a position to do so, here’s a personalized link where you can pitch in:**
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250530-2?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250530-2.oI369D&refcode=em20250530-8980-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=8980%2E2526796%2E3QErqU)
Whether you can donate today or not, thank you so much for being a part of this campaign. On behalf of my entire team: we’re so grateful that you’re here.
Pa’lante,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20250530-2?refcode=em20250530-8980-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=22&refcode2=8980_2526796_3QErqU&akid=8980%2E2526796%2E3QErqU)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20250530-8980-P_FND_EGR_GRM&t=23&akid=8980%2E2526796%2E3QErqU)**

body:
---
**BREAKING: DNC, DSCC, and DCCC Move to Intervene at the U.S. Supreme Court to Block Trump and Republicans’ Attempt to Let Billionaires Buy our Elections** [**Pitch in now to help support Democrats’ work to defend our right to a democracy free from political corruption:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2025?refcode=em_20250530_3606_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3606_22930333_gNk-N_&akid=3606%2E22930333%2EgNk-N_) **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2025?refcode=em_20250530_3606_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3606_22930333_gNk-N_&akid=3606%2E22930333%2EgNk-N_)** We know there’s a lot of news happening right now, so we wanted to make sure you didn't miss this, Derek: For decades, the Republican Party has tried to eliminate reasonable limits on how much political parties can spend in coordination with candidates’ campaigns. Those efforts have failed at every turn. But now, Trump — alongside national Republicans’ congressional campaign committees — is urging the Supreme Court to remove the limits on the amount of money that donors can funnel to candidates through party committees’ coordinated expenditures. **To put it simply, this is a blatant attempt to let billionaires buy our elections.** So Democrats are fighting back. Today, the DNC — along with the DSCC and DCCC — just filed a motion to intervene to protect our country’s campaign finance laws. We’re using every tool at our disposal — including aggressively confronting Trump in the courts — to ensure the American people have the loudest voices in our democracy. [But we’ll be honest: Lawsuits like these are costly, and we rely on supporters like you — _not billionaires_ — to help make them possible. If work like this is worth a few dollars to you, we hope you’ll consider making a $3 contribution now to help fund it.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2025?refcode=em_20250530_3606_fr&amount=3&refcode2=3606_22930333_gNk-N_&akid=3606%2E22930333%2EgNk-N_) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-may-2025?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20250530_3606_fr&refcode2=3606_22930333_gNk-N_&akid=3606%2E22930333%2EgNk-N_)**

| Peter, I just released my annual financial disclosure form, and it only took me 5 minutes – because I don’t own any stocks.

And that’s exactly what Republicans love attacking me for: not being rich. They can attack me all they want, but I have no shame. Unlike them, I haven’t abused my office to get rich off stock trading.

When I ran for Congress, I drove for Uber and took on credit card debt just to get by. And after my swearing in, I got denied from apartments in D.C. because of my credit.

So it’s funny when I get called out for experiencing the struggles that working class Americans experience everyday – because shouldn’t we have more leaders who know what it’s like? I think if we did, Congress would work a lot better than it does now.

And that’s exactly what Republicans love attacking me for: not being rich. They can attack me all they want, but I have no shame. Unlike them, I haven’t abused my office to get rich off stock trading. When I ran for Congress, I drove for Uber and took on credit card debt just to get by. And after my swearing in, I got denied from apartments in D.C. because of my credit. So it’s funny when I get called out for experiencing the struggles that working class Americans experience everyday – because shouldn’t we have more leaders who know what it’s like? I think if we did, Congress would work a lot better than it does now. I’m proud to represent us, and I’m committed to fighting for all of us.
